**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The only MFN-type language in the Agreement benefits us. In § 6 (p0047), TrueLink commits that Hosting Services costs will not increase for one year and that "rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party" — a Vendor-granted MFN in the Customer's favour, which the playbook expressly welcomes.

I searched for reciprocal formulations ("most favored", "no less favorable", "favorable", "best", "any other party", exclusivity language) and reviewed the Compensation section in full. There is no obligation requiring Mortgage Logic.com to extend TrueLink terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, and no obligation to match third-party offers. § 5 imposes only ordinary fee, invoicing and payment duties.

This sits at the preferred position (no MFN burdening the Customer), so per the rule's direction guidance the clause is left untouched.
